mindset_focus_options.name: Financial
mindset_focus_options.definition: Cares about making the most money and having opportunities outside of football fame.

mindset_focus_options.definition: Cares about being the best they can be and wants opportunities to prove that.

mindset_focus_options.name: Winning
mindset_focus_options.definition: Cares about winning and being part of an organization that constantly tries to field contending teams.

questions.question: Your team is deciding who gets the final roster spot at your position. What's your gut reaction?

options.text: Whoever helps the team most, full stop.
I go coach the younger guy up myself.
I make sure the room knows where I stand on it.
Not my call to make noise about.
Whatever they decide, I'll own my role in making it work.
I'd rather the room actually talk it through together.

questions.question: Extension talks open. What's your approach at the table?

options.text: Every clause matters to me — structure, terms, all of it.
I push hard and fast for the number I want.
I can wait as long as it takes for the right deal.
I'd rather take less and know it's guaranteed.
I've already run the numbers three different ways before we sit down.
I push until every term favors me more than their first offer.

questions.question: You just had the worst game of your career, publicly. How do you handle the next 48 hours?

options.text: I'm back to normal fast — it doesn't linger.
It stays with me longer than it should.
I don't let it show either way.
The criticism actually gets to me.
I stay even-keeled, at least on the outside.
I use it — I come back sharper and angrier.

questions.question: What's actually pulling you out of bed for a 5 a.m. lift?

options.text: Getting to the next level, faster than people expect.
Doing it the right way, even when no one's watching.
I genuinely just love this.
Staying realistic about what's actually in front of me.
I stick to the plan, no matter how I feel that morning.
I don't think about it, I just show up and do the work.

questions.question: A reporter asks you a pointed question about your future with the team. What comes out?

options.text: Whatever I'm actually thinking — no filter.
Something that keeps everyone happy.
As little as possible.
Exactly what I mean, plainly.
I keep my answer vague — no reason to give them more.
I say it once, and I'm not walking it back no matter who pushes.

questions.question: Locker room energy before kickoff. What's actually going on in your head?

options.text: I'm hyping guys up — that's my role in this room.
I already know how this one's going to go.
I stay even — this is just another Sunday to me.
Depends on the day, honestly — even I don't always know.
I'm thinking about who's watching back home.
Whatever it takes today, I don't care how it looks.

questions.question: A trade rumor with your name in it starts making the rounds.

options.text: I already know how these things usually shake out.
If a better situation opens up somewhere else, I'm taking it.
At the end of the day, I control where my career goes, not them.
I've made it clear where I stand, and that's not changing.
I want to know exactly what's actually being discussed.
I think about what actually makes sense long-term, not the noise.

questions.question: The front office asks you to take a below-market deal, citing your history together.

options.text: If they've always treated me right, I'll meet them halfway.
I've kept my word to this team — I expect the same back.
History or not, I'm not caving on this one.
I'd rather just sit down and talk it through honestly.
I notice exactly how this compares to what other guys are getting.
I get it — I know the cap situation they're working with.

questions.question: Offseason program starts. What's actually driving how you train?

options.text: There's always more tape, more to learn.
I'm building toward exactly where I want to be in five years.
I need to be better than every guy at my position, period.
I want people to notice the work, not just see the results.
I think about how this offseason affects where the team is in three years, not just me.
Whatever the plan calls for, I adjust and get it done.

questions.question: Contract talks stall and your agent asks how you want to play it from here.

options.text: I'm not moving off my number. Full stop.
I want to go back through every clause again before we respond.
I tell them exactly how I feel about where this stands.
I need more from them before I trust this is real.
This isn't something I'm going to joke around about.
I want to understand exactly why they're holding this line.
